criterion.ownedTruth: The diagnostic sharpens a real high-value decision instead of producing business-horoscope prose.
passConditions: Each non-cold result identifies a concrete decision tension grounded in that exact business.
The useful and rich cases reach strategy, economics, allocation or another genuinely consequential mechanism.
The one question names information whose answer could select, kill or materially reshape a route.
Specificity and decision value rise materially with evidence depth.
failConditions: The advice could be pasted into an unrelated company with little change.
The question merely invites reflection, learning or activity without changing a decision.
The output optimises admin, generic adoption or micro-learning rather than the consequential call.

hardVetoRules.condition: The richer profiles still reduce to generic business advice with no evidence-linked decision mechanism.

shared.label: Human agency
shared.rule: Humans own purpose, boundaries, standards, exceptions and the final consequential call.

shared.label: Evidence standing
shared.rule: Keep explicit facts, inferred candidates and behavioural feedback as different data types.

shared.label: Subject and audience boundary
shared.rule: Prove subject, ownership, audience and authority before an item can travel or act.

shared.label: Behavioural reality
shared.rule: Judge the real task and consequence, not an elegant description of the intended system.

optional.label: Reversibility and premortem
optional.rule: Test reversibility, premortem failure and opportunity cost separately from predicted upside.

optional.label: Decision quality
optional.rule: Assess the quality of the decision process separately from the eventual outcome.

optional.label: Recognition-first intake
optional.rule: Interpret the evidence first, then ask one concrete question only when its answer can change the route.
